name: C1
description: Explore-phase swing (2026-11-09): reproduce first. Before editing, the agent writes a short script OUTSIDE the repository (/tmp/repro.py) that exercises the behaviour the issue describes and shows it failing; after the edit it reruns it and only submits once it passes. Hypothesis: B3 showed the main failure mode is wrong logic (about 17 of 30 patches fail verification), which a structural gate cannot see; a concrete executable check taken from the issue text can. The repro lives in /tmp, so it never enters the patch or touches protected test files.
